# Amp fixtures

These texts are the sanitized lines quoted in public CodexBar issues, not captures from this machine.

- `subscription.txt` matches the credit-parser report in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2435
  (`Subscription Megawatt: … remaining - resets upon renewal in 29 days`).
- `megawatt.txt` matches the later line in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/3050
  (`Amp Megawatt Subscription: … in 1 month`) plus an individual-credits line.
- `credits.txt` is only a dollar balance, which must not become a percent.

The address `you@example.com` is the one already used in those issues.
